meanings.definition: Having a fever, an elevated body temperature.; Filled with excess energy.
examples: The illness made him feverish, so they applied cold compresses.
He worked with feverish excitement.
A feverish desire to see her again.

meanings.definition: Out of the ordinary; odd; strange; unusual.; Common or usual for a certain place or circumstance; specific or particular.
examples: The sky had a peculiar appearance before the storm.
It would be rather peculiar to see a kangaroo hopping down a city street.
Kangaroos are peculiar to Australia.

meanings.definition: To squander or waste time, money, or other resources; e.g. occupy oneself idly or without clear purpose, to tinker with an unimportant part of a project, to dally, sometimes as a form of procrastination.; To sinter.
examples: I was supposed to do work, but I frittered around all afternoon.
He can’t figure out how to finish the paper he’s writing, so he’s resorted to frittering with the fonts.
It is quite possible to fritter one's life away in answer to the endless calls of others.
